description: This file defines the RestRequest class which facilitates making REST API calls via cURL, supporting methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE, and handling request setup, execution, and response processing.

classes.name: RestRequest
classes.description: A class for constructing and executing REST API requests with support for various HTTP verbs and request configurations.

methods.name: openConnect
methods.description: Initializes a connection with specified URL, method, and request data, setting up necessary request parameters.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Resets request-specific properties to default values, clearing previous request data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the HTTP request using cURL, handling connection setup, and response retrieval, with option to keep connection alive.

methods.name: buildPostBody
methods.description: Constructs the request body, potentially including file data or JSON-encoded data, and sets appropriate headers.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body received after executing the request.

methods.name: getResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the last response, such as HTTP status code.

methods.name: lastRequestStatus
methods.description: Checks if the last request was successful based on the HTTP status code.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Performs the actual cURL execution and captures response info.

methods.name: setCurlOpts
methods.description: Sets various cURL options based on current request parameters, including proxy and SSL settings.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Sets HTTP Basic Authentication if username and password are provided.
